questions.prompt: Which of these countries stayed neutral in the Second World War?
questions.fact: Norway and Belgium both declared themselves neutral and were invaded anyway in 1940.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries are in South America?
questions.fact: Panama is the narrow join between the two continents and counts as Central America.

questions.prompt: How many seconds are there in one day?
questions.fact: 86,400. A day is slowly getting longer, by about two thousandths of a second a century.

questions.prompt: How many years did Nelson Mandela spend in prison?
questions.fact: 27 years, 18 of them on Robben Island. Four years after his release he was elected president.

questions.prompt: Which is the longest river in Europe?
questions.hint: It flows into the Caspian Sea.
questions.fact: The Volga runs about 3,500 km through Russia. The Danube comes second.

questions.prompt: In which sport do teams play for the Stanley Cup?
questions.fact: The Stanley Cup was first awarded in 1893 and is named after a Governor General of Canada.
